description: The parser layers expression methods so tighter operations form deeper AST nodes.

steps.description: parse_expr recognizes assignment when an identifier is followed by =. Otherwise it starts with logical or.
The or, and, and comparison levels build BinOp nodes from their lower-precedence operands.
Additive and multiplicative methods loop over their operators. The caret branch returns a power BinOp from this level.
Unary minus and not recursively parse an operand. parse_call wraps a primary expression in Call nodes for parenthesized arguments.
Argument parsing reads comma-separated expressions. Primary parsing creates literal, variable, and parenthesized nodes.
Primary parsing also handles if expressions and lambdas, then raises ParseError for any unsupported token.

title: Parse expressions by precedence
